name: Paper-derived statistical calibration for compressed SAM2 memory reads
status: implemented; unit checks passed; real-frame gate not yet run

source.paper: Statistically Calibrated Scaling for Token Merging in Transformers
source.venue: ICML 2026, Proceedings of Machine Learning Research 306
source.code_status: The linked repository has no source files; this integration reuses this project's pinned official ToMe matcher and weighted-merge operation and transcribes the paper's stated scaling equations.

question: Does the paper-derived correction reduce damage from fixed-budget ToMe when reading SAM2 spatial memory, and does region-constrained matching add benefit beyond generic matching?

method.location: After existing ToMe compression of projected post-RoPE spatial memory K/V and before frozen SAM2 SDPA.
method.retention_ratio: r = compressed spatial-key count / original spatial-key count for that read.
method.key_logits: Scale compressed spatial K by sqrt(r), equivalent to scaling merged logits by sqrt(r).
method.values: Scale compressed spatial V by sqrt(r).
method.mass_prior: Scale additive log(cluster-size) attention bias by 1-sqrt(r), implementing T(z,n)=sqrt(r)*z+(1-sqrt(r))*log(n).
method.pointers: Never merge or scale object-pointer K/V; their additive bias remains zero.
method.training: None. SAM2 checkpoint and all model weights remain frozen.

important_limit: The paper's derivation is for Transformer self-attention without SAM2's separately appended object-pointer tokens. Applying it only to SAM2's spatial-memory partition is a reasoned adaptation; its theoretical calibration is not guaranteed in this mixed spatial/pointer cross-attention. It is not a targeted Seq5 object-presence or reappearance fix.
controls: Each calibrated arm must replay the exact merge assignments and per-frame/window token budgets of its uncalibrated counterpart. Generic and regional treatments must have matched token counts using the existing frozen plan. No hyperparameter search.

checks: native replay exactly matches the archived reference
uncalibrated arms retain the existing seq2/seq3 gate invariants
calibrated arms use the same merge counts, assignments and source-frame schedule as their corresponding uncalibrated arms
all four attention layers are intercepted once per target
object-pointer keys/values and positions are bit-identical
SAM2 parameters, native memory writes, current queries, prompts, frame schedule, decoder and presence handling are unchanged
calibrated tensors and propagated outputs are finite
two fresh-process gate runs have identical result records
engineering_gate.failure_rule: Any failed invariant stops the gate. Do not relax tolerances or proceed to efficacy evaluation.

efficacy.status: not authorized until an independent review accepts the real-frame gate
efficacy.scope: all 21 eligible PolypGen sequences, excluding seq1 and seq7, full-video propagation
efficacy.primary: Equal-sequence mean Dice on post-prompt GT-present frames.
efficacy.stopping: Use the active research goal's frozen meaningful-improvement screen; no criterion changes after observing validation or test results.
